# The toolset's Processes

The toolset's own [Processes](https://litlfred.github.io/bootstrap/schemas/#process), in bootstrap's diagram vocabulary: `render-kg-to-github-pages.bpmn`, rendering a [Knowledge Graph](https://litlfred.github.io/bootstrap/schemas/#knowledge-graph) (or a list of its [Subgraphs](https://litlfred.github.io/bootstrap/schemas/#subgraph)) to GitHub Pages at a publication root URL, with each step one of these tools and the push's status and message as its output. The same process for a staging preview and a release; only the root URL differs.

Part of [Bootstrap tools](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `bootstrap-tools-processes`, holding `processes`.

| file | what it is | used by |
|---|---|---|
| [`render-kg-to-github-pages.bpmn`](render-kg-to-github-pages.bpmn) | a [Process](https://litlfred.github.io/bootstrap/schemas/#process): Render a [Knowledge Graph](https://litlfred.github.io/bootstrap/schemas/#knowledge-graph) to GitHub Pages |  |
